source_name: Banky.sk – zoznam bánk na Slovensku (consumer portal directory)
why_relevant: Non-official but conveniently structured directory of Slovak banks and of the SBA itself, useful as a quick alias/brand-name table (trading names vs legal names) for text-matching bank names in tender notices.
Model of a large semi-private buyer publishing its own tender index off the state system; template for how utility/corporate instances expose data, and relevant for cross-sector IT/payments sourcing.
Additional Slovak tender aggregation/monitoring portal surfaced alongside the main players; worth profiling for coverage of non-state buyers.

entity_name: EY Slovakia / Big Four SK insight pages on IT & tech transactions
source_name: EY Slovakia / Big Four SK insight pages on IT & tech transactions
why_relevant: Consultancy commentary on the Slovak IT/tech transaction market, incl. financial-sector technology deals; gives market framing and occasionally names deal activity not covered by media.

source_name: JUDr. Ondrušek – právny blog (transparency / public-sector partners register)
why_relevant: Lawyer blog focused on public-sector transparency and the Register partnerov verejného sektora — the disclosure regime that reveals beneficial owners of firms winning state financial/IT contracts.

source_name: Prima banka Slovensko – corporate site (procurement discovery entry point)
why_relevant: Prima banka is present in every Slovak district (largest branch estate relative to size) making its branch-IT and self-service device sourcing commercially significant. No public supplier page found; the site's preview-file PDF tree is the practical crawl target.

Publications Office front end presenting individual procurement records (including banking-services CPV 66110000 examples) with a stable UUID-based URL scheme; a secondary rendering of TED content useful for human verification and reusers' workshop material.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International – group site (parent sourcing for Tatra banka)
why_relevant: Tatra banka is an RBI subsidiary; where no SK supplier page exists, RBI group procurement/vendor policy and any group e-sourcing tool is the upstream channel. Also confirms the legal-entity mapping needed for contract and registry lookups.

source_name: SIMAP — European public procurement information (SK version)
why_relevant: Explains thresholds, CPV nomenclature and the legal basis that determines which Slovak banking/payment contracts must appear at EU level — the rulebook for interpreting coverage and for setting CPV filters.

source_name: Tatra banka corporate site – supplier/procurement discovery entry point
why_relevant: Searches for a Tatra banka supplier portal returned only MERCHANT-side portals (Obchodnícky portál, splátkový portál) - a documented naming collision. The corporate site remains the entry point for any future 'pre dodávateľov' page; its /files/sk/ PDF tree is indexable and is where procurement conditions would most likely be published.

Bidder-side service summarising and alerting on Vestník notices; secondary value as an alerting redundancy and as a plain-language guide to notice types (oznámenie o vyhlásení VO vs o výsledku VO) used in parsing rules.

source_name: UniCredit Group corporate portal domain (supplier-side lead)
why_relevant: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia sources via UniCredit group procurement. The group's portal domain is the only concrete endpoint located this run; the actual supplier/fornitori registration URL was NOT found and remains an open lead rather than a confirmed source.

source_name: Wolters Kluwer SR – journal 'Verejné obstarávanie – právo a prax'
why_relevant: Bi-monthly professional journal written by procurement lawyers and practitioners; authoritative on procedural changes and case law that shape how financial/IT tenders are run and contested.

source_name: World Bank Group procurement notices (Finances One / Data Catalog)
why_relevant: Structured dataset of WBG-financed procurement notices. Slovakia is not a borrowing country, so volume is expected to be near-zero, but WBG Reimbursable Advisory Services in Slovakia can generate consultancy procurement touching public financial management/payments.
